messages:
Alex P.: Quick async check — console observability roadmap: who is signed up to own final delivery for dashboards, tracing hooks, error-analysis views, and retention milestones? We need clear owners before the EOW milestone (Wed).

Priya Nair: I can own the error-analysis views, but I need the span + metrics schema from eng-sre and the sample alerts we want surfaced.

Marcus Lee: I will take dashboards (visuals, panels, templates). Blocking note: infra needs to run the retention migration in staging before we can enable some panels. @Tanya can you confirm infra dependency/ETA?

Tanya Gomez: Eng-SRE will take tracing hooks and the retention enablement work. ETA for migration in staging is Tue 10:00am PT. We need a small schema patch for spans (see below).

Ben Chu: For the regression/eval hooks that feed error-analysis, I can deliver the initial prompt sets + evaluation harness by Mon. One quick Q: retention TTL target for traces/logs? 90d or 180d?

Priya Nair: Prefer 180d for logs and error payloads, but traces can be 90d. Metrics/dashboard data should stay longer (365d) for trend analysis. @Marcus fyi.

Marcus Lee: Ack. I'll update the ownership matrix and the rollout plan. Can someone paste the exact retention config snippet we want infra to apply so I can attach it to the ticket?

Tanya Gomez: Snippet below that we plan to push to infra (will open PR after CI runs):
```
retention:
  traces: 90d
  metrics: 365d
  logs: 180d
```
Sending to infra and tagging the migration job.

ci-bot: Deploy pipeline started for retention-migration (job #4421) — watcher set: @tanya @marcus.

Alex P.: Great — action items recap: Marcus update matrix + rollout canary, Priya collect schema & alerts, Ben share eval prompts, Tanya push migration PR and confirm job passes, infra runs job. Flag blockers here; if the migration slips we push canary by one week. :thumbsup:

Marcus Lee: I'll own the canary plan (target Fri for limited customer roll). Will post the canary checklist here once PR is opened.

Priya Nair: I'll drop the sample span schema and example alert payload in this thread by EOD.

Ben Chu: Uploading prompt sets to the eval bucket Monday morning and will add a short README.

Tanya Gomez: CI passed for job #4421 (job finished at 1768554387). Migration PR incoming in ~15m.

Alex P.: Perfect — thanks everyone. If no major issues, we'll treat this as the EOW milestone gating sync.
